description: What peeking does to an A/B test: the real false positive rate if you check a fixed-horizon test K times and stop at the first p < alpha (for example about 14% at 5 looks with alpha 0.05), and the Pocock and O'Brien-Fleming group sequential boundaries (z and nominal p per look) that keep the overall rate at alpha, for up to 10 equally spaced looks.

looks.description: How many times the result is checked, including the final look. Equally spaced.

name: check_peeking_risk
title: A/B test peeking and sequential testing risk
